name: Hulking Demon raises attack power from Stamina and hit rating from Agility (#940)
contract: Hulking Demon 805246 effect 0 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_ATTACK_POWER_OF_STAT_PERCENT, misc=2 Stamina) and effect 1 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_RATING_FROM_STAT, misc=160 covers CR_HIT_MELEE bit 5 and CR_HIT_SPELL bit 7, miscb=1 Agility) are real unconditional handlers (HandleAuraModAttackPowerOfStatPercent, HandleModRatingFromStat) that operate on the caster's own stats with no classmask gating. The exact percentages depend on the caster's raw Stamina/Agility, which this harness has no query to read as an independent input, so this proves the handlers are consumed (a nonzero, correctly-signed change) rather than pinning the literal 30%/6% coefficients.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Melee hit rating rises from Agility
